subject: religious-studies
title: The World's Holy Books
welcome_lead: Open the pages of the world's sacred scriptures and meet the texts that guide billions.
meta_desc: KS3 Religious Studies adventure exploring the major sacred texts of world religions.
final_note: You can now name the holy books of all six major world religions.

concepts.def: Christian sacred text: Old and New Testaments.
Holy book of Islam, revealed to Muhammad.
First five books of Jewish scripture (Tanakh).
Earliest Buddhist scriptures, in three baskets.
Sacred scripture of Sikhism, treated as Guru.

walkthroughs.body_html: The Bible (Christianity) contains the Old Testament (shared with Judaism's Tanakh) and the New Testament about Jesus. The Quran (Islam) was revealed in Arabic to the Prophet Muhammad. The Torah is the first five books of the Jewish Tanakh.
Hindus revere the Vedas and Upanishads — ancient teachings about reality and the soul. Buddhists follow the Tripitaka (Three Baskets). Sikhs treat the Guru Granth Sahib as their living eternal Guru.
Sacred texts give guidance on how to live, explain the universe, contain prayers and stories, and bind communities together. They are read in homes, services and ceremonies around the world.

mcqs.q: What are the first five books of the Jewish Tanakh called?
options: The Torah
The Vedas
The Tripitaka
The Gospels
Substance dualism means men and women are different.
Aquinas's Five Ways are five steps of one cosmological argument.
Aquinas's Five Ways are five Christian sacraments.

Five distinct arguments for God's existence: from motion, causation, contingency, gradation of being, and final causes/teleology — collectively forming Aquinas's natural theology, not a single argument.

mcqs.q: What is substance dualism about mind and body?
options: Substance dualism means men and women are different.
The Quran was written by Allah and dropped from heaven.
Substance dualism is the belief that humans have two personalities.
The view (associated with Descartes) that mind and body are two distinct kinds of substance — a non-physical mind interacting with a physical body.

mcqs.q: How do Muslims believe the Quran was revealed?
options: The Quran was written by Allah and dropped from heaven.
Muhammad wrote the Quran based on his own teachings.
Through the angel Jibril (Gabriel) to Muhammad over 23 years; Muslims believe it is the literal word of God, not Muhammad's own words.
Substance dualism means men and women are different.
